post.description:
Queues the revert of a sync_failed request: the worker marks it reverted and opens a new request that
restores the folder as it was before the plan, through the same approval rules, in one transaction. The new
request's ID is in the events.

**Requires** `requests:retry`.

parameters.description: The request's ID, as the write that opened the request returned it.
parameters.name: request_id

schema.description: The request's ID, as the write that opened the request returned it.
schema.title: Request Id

value.detail: cancel is not allowed in state merged
value.title: invalid transition

get.description:
The tiers offered per environment with their quota and LimitRange values, the custom bounds, and the
catalog hash a rendered quota carries as cmapi.net/tier-hash.

**Requires** `objects:read`.
